statement: AMD held $8.468 billion of inventories as of June 27, 2026, with no comparative prior-period balance given in the release.
why: Inventory carried at a vendor is part of the whole-chain stock of accelerators; a large balance alongside accelerating guidance is more likely a build-ahead for shipment than unsold product, but the release gives no baseline to tell.

impact.mechanism: Finished and work-in-process accelerator inventory at the vendor is supply staged ahead of a guided second-half ramp, which eases near-term availability.

evidence.source: AMD Investor Relations (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.)

confidence.basis: Balance-sheet line stated in the issuer's own press release; direction of change is unstated so trend is left unknown.

dispersion: No prior-period inventory balance disclosed in this release, so the change cannot be sized.
